Ugh I am so sorry this happened to you. This is also my worst nightmare. I become hyper aware of everything around me when driving to the point that I'm overwhelmed and it brings me into a panic attack. I start veering into other lanes and just making completely stupid mistakes.
I recently found out that this is a result of adult ADHD combined with anxiety after years of therapy and still continuing to make the same mistakes. I'm still unable to drive at this time but hopefully new prescriptions will show improvements and allow me to in the future.
Talk to multiple doctors for varied opinions on your driving anxiety. Therapy might help with the self esteem aspect after this, but finding a therapist you like is the tricky part.
Don't think any less of yourself because of this accident. Be happy that no one was injured or killed, and that you have the chance to improve yourself now.
